provenance: Recorded-real candidate snapshots. Empty until the opt-in live recorder populates it. Each recorded case stores the source provider, the query, the UTC observation date, and per-provider ranks, titles, and normalized URLs only; page bodies are never stored. No case is fabricated: if the recorder cannot reach live dispatch it fails instead of writing a file.
annotation_uncertainty: Recorded provider order is not relevance truth. Cases must carry hand-adjudicated relevant_documents written without reading the recorded rank order; until then judgments_complete is false and the case is reported as unjudged.
